text:
```yaml
name: Downstream Compatibility

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  downstream-compat:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          activate-environment: true
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install --system -e .[dev]

      - name: Run downstream compatibility tests
        run: |
          uv run pytest tests/downstream_compat/ -v --tb=short

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: Downstream Compatibility Tests
          path: "*.xml"
          reporter: python-pytest
```
